Text: Were those two passersby talking about a research program...?
Looks like Sequence Square is becoming the Science Council's new satellite office for overtime work.
I finally finished the work at hand.
I'll also try to indulge a bit at Stella Brew.
Life in the movie is totally unlike reality today.
How I yearn for the Golden Age we lost...
Good job, gummy bear...
Nuclear submarine out of food during cruise. Crew survived entirely on gummy bears.
Is this how they write all news headlines nowadays?
It's all love now. You've got so many Cogs!
Public database access granted to citizens based on clearance levels
It includes information from various disciplines, lifestyle tidbits, and—what? Gossip?
This shouldn't be included... right?
Thankfully, there's a holographic tree at the Sequence Square.
At least we can track what season it is on Earth.
Though occasionally there are mix-ups.
I remember the holographic tree had a technical glitch last time.
It was a projection of summertime this morning, and now it's winter in the afternoon.
It ended up showing people in t-shirts during a snowstorm.
Just send the new mattress to the workstation directly.
I spend more nights at the Council than at home anyway...
This is a fountain pen used by Asimov—
I knew that working as a janitor at the Science Council would be a promising career path!
You can smell the simulated grass and earth when you approach the detailed projection.
The head chef requested the more fragrant dishes to be placed in front of the fan.
This way, the aroma will spread farther and draw in customers.
We're the 90th in line for a table...
Next time, I'll just hire someone to stand in line for me.
Some guests have been asking about dyeing their hair in two or three colors.
Someone even asked for a rainbow-colored dye...
I just can't keep up with trends anymore.
Would you be interested in our shop's special dry hair spray?
We have models for both humans and Constructs!
Excellent choice!
This haute couture collection is designed by a master from the WGAA. It's very difficult to get!
I heard from the staff that someone raided the pharmacy and ate all the digestive medicine like it was candy.
And ended up in the Star of Life's ER that night.
That's why this medicine can only be purchased in limited quantities via a real-name system.
The buy-one-get-one-free hot dog promotion is finally here!
Let me think about who to drag with us to eat here...
Why do the vendors always come asking to borrow ice cubes—
I've told them so many times already.
The Cedar Shop doesn't sell ice!
It's truly the hardest to haggle with an Akdilek vendor...
Didn't get the discount I was hoping for.
Got sweet-talked into buying several more things instead.
There's a couple ahead, and another pair diagonally behind us.
There are couples down every walkable path...
There are way too many people on dates here.
Say, are you guys here on Gestalt's suggestion, too...?
That's right, and I'm Sweetie!
Ugh, I just mistook someone for someone else. That was embarrassing.
Maybe I should do some shopping.
We'll come back to buy it after we've been to the Restaurant Area.
I like the mousse cake here more than their coffee.
Theoretically, Constructs are no longer affected by caffeine stimulation.
I still prefer to freshen up with a cup of electrolyte coffee.
Probably just because I'm used to it.
They're prepared in exactly the same way, though
Why does their coffee taste better...?
Wait, we need to keep a low profile.
I run the shop next door, and I can't let people see me.
Oh! The Gray Raven Commandant! What would you like to order?
They always make me do the coffee run.
We just ran into people from the Science Council.
Let's go back and ask the boss if we can just get a prepaid card at the coffee shop...
Customers who register as members can enjoy a free drink every week!
This month only: DIY Latte Art! Save more with our set menu for two.
This new item really tastes amazing.

I wonder what I should go with...
How about we have a look at the next shop?
J-just one last time, then I'm definitely going on a diet!
Star of Life nutritional recommendation... I'll go with this one.
My turn now! Action Surge!
Ohhh, go get 'em, Berserker!
Drink two healing potions!
Why play a Berserker if you're such a chicken?!
Want to try a Tank-type CUB?
The best defense is a good offense! I don't need that!
Keep talking like that, and you can fix your own frame next time.
I can't believe they have Heraclitus's famous works here!
Ma'am, feel free to sample any of the products in this section.
I heard Emma uses this brand...
The ARU hiking boots are of great quality.
Let's buy one more scarf before we go.
Why are the games more expensive than the console itself...
Hey, is my honey-glazed barbecue ready yet?
Really? These are Master Ji Yin's work.
Hey, how did you know that?
I recognize the pattern. I learned about these at the Youth Training Center.
Kowloong's classical art always has this sense of harmonious beauty to it.
I have way too many holographic plants at home...
His squad has been out of contact for a long time now... What if...
You're completely drunk. Stop drinking already.
No... I can't accept the project... hic!
Given how limited our budget is... That totally makes sense.
We were so close... hic!
I heard someone spotted the Gray Raven Commandant around here.
But I've been sitting here for two weeks already...
Support Force recommended their special blend... I can't wait to taste it.
Let time slow down in this cup—
Welcome to Stella Brew.
The Commercial District's been renovated.
What a pleasant surprise.
To think I'd ever see my designs come to life...
I guess that's what makes this profession worthwhile. No regrets now.
Have you forgotten your own words?
To build foundations beyond the Solar System!
We're still a long way from the finish line!
Anyone need a guided tour?
I've got a tip... it's about Kuroro Coffee.
Really? Tell me everything!
This place has such a wonderful atmosphere.
Looks like all the greenery here is real.
I learned quite a lot today.
I can't believe you actually like this place...
Look over there! It's the Gray Raven Commandant!
Oh my god, where is my terminal... I need to take a picture!
Hey, you should ask for permission first!
...Expecting success is nothing but a pipe dream.
We should gaze at the stars like everyone else from the Third Department...
This is what you taught me. I will never give up.
...I'm giving you one last chance to run your experiment.
How's the team?
Everyone in the squad is doing fine... What about you?
It's been a long time since I last saw a doctor from the Star of Life.
...Stay safe, and you gotta make sure I'm safe, too.
...Because he has excellent Tantalum affinity.
Huh? So you didn't stop him?
This is his dream.
So you...
I respect his decision.
On patrol... I'm on patrol...
Central system self-diagnostic: 78% complete...
It says here... there's going to be a concert tonight?
Is this really what they eat on the ARU?
I finally finished the work at hand.
I'll also try to indulge a bit at Stella Brew.
Nothing beats lattes!
Cappuccinos blow everything else out of the water!
Perfect! Let's mix the coffee in these proportions.
Are you really... sure about this?
Don't you get it? The art of mixing creates perfection.
What's that weird smell?
It smells like... a pharmacy in Kowloong.
Seats here are big.
Indeed, the tables and chairs are quite comfortable, too.
There should be enough space here for work documents.
Why don't we bring our documents over right now—
Didn't we agree not to talk about work during our date today?!
Which restaurant should we go to later?
I can't decide...
Why don't you just close your eyes and point at one randomly?
How about this one? What kind of cuisine is it?
...You just picked a clothing store.
Have you heard about what happened on Earth recently?
I think there's military tension in some region.
I really wish I could join the Elite Squad and help out...
Hey, been a while, Gray Raven Commandant!
The combat training room got some new toys. Want to go try it out?
Great idea! As luck would have it, I already booked a spot for today.
Let's go then. Perfect chance for us to spar together.
The food tasting event at Kowloong Restaurant will begin shortly.
Let's hurry up. If we're late, we won't be able to get in.
You promised a treat, and we end up at a vending machine?
You aren't seriously just gonna get me a drink now, are you?!
The first drink in the second row is the most expensive one. I'll have that.
Colds are never fun. Let's pick up some more medicine for you.
What dishes would you like to order?
Whatever, I'm fine with anything.
Then let's go with their signature combo meal.
No way, I don't like desserts, and besides—
Then don't say you're fine with anything if you're going to be picky!
I was only away for a minute and the dish is gone?
I just wanted a little taste...
It was irresistible...
Didn't you all say you didn't want this when we were ordering?
I'm still hungry, can I order another serving? Pretty please?
Gotta try their fried pork belly when you're here.
Wait. Didn't you say that you are on a diet these days?
Gotta fill myself up first to be able to do that, though.
Is that why you ordered five plates of meat again?
Let's enjoy our meal first and worry about everything else later.
Burp... I'm stuffed and well-hydrated.
Tell you what, I could spend every day of the week here...
Please help yourself to the condiments, beverages, and fruits.
"Kowloong Restaurant's Must-Try Dishes"?
And dishes from Kuflip's live cooking showcase menu.
Sounds impressive, but I've never heard of them.
Kuflip came up with the list, apparently.
Wait, he put that awful dish at the top of the list?
This looks more like a list of must-not-try to me now...
Are you sure you want to try this?
Eat it a few more times and you'll be immune.
Wait, what in the world is...
Hold it right there! That's clearly an allergic reaction!
Are you sure you're actually gonna wear all these things you bought?
Of course, different outfits are for different occasions.
You're not gonna wear these to work, are you...
Right, speaking of which, what do you usually wear for work?
...The clothes I usually keep buried at the bottom of my closet.
We've walked along the Orbital Corridor for so long. Let's take a break...
But you've already been resting for close to an hour.
Studying the city map is also part of learning...
These scenic photos have nourished Black Kuroro's soul!
That's just because your storage is full, you idiot.
Charging system update in progress. Please do not disturb.
Today's maintenance progress: 75% complete. Battery remaining: 60%.
Patrol scan complete. Initiating cleansing protocol.
Kuleaner—activating automatic clean mode.
Is today's Communication Bulletin out yet?
James's squad hasn't been in contact for a week now, has it?
I remember that mission wasn't supposed to be particularly difficult.
But you can never be sure when it comes to surface missions...
I need you to keep that thing for a few more days.
Lily hasn't returned from her mission yet?
That's right... I spent so much time picking out that gift for her.
We promised we'd celebrate Prof's birthday together...
Please don't break your promise.
I didn't have a choice before, but now I want to be a good person.
Sure, go tell it to the judge.
You're not showing any emotion at all.
You're the one trying to join the WGAA, not me!
I'm already doing you a favor by helping you rehearse during my vacation.
Look how rich and vivid this emotion is...
Isn't today team building for the squad?
Why is it just the two of us?
Get real. When have the girls ever taken us shopping with them?
Yesterday's experiment—anything wrong with the parameters?
It's already been fixed. Stop asking about it.
I'm just gonna get more curious when you act like that.
...Well, then, if you really can't contain your curiosity.
Boss forgot to update the data. That's all.
Are we dieting today or heading to Kowloong Restaurant?
Have you heard about that amazing book everyone's talking about?
Huh? What book?
Shh, I'll show you when we get back to the lounge.
Sure is making me curious...
I've got a bold idea.
Let's research a portable virtual pet that people can carry around!
You could interact with it anytime—feeding, grooming, that sort of thing!
Sounds awesome, doesn't it?
Perhaps... have you heard of digital pets?
Strange. Shouldn't it be right around here?
Where did I put it?
What are you looking for?
Some sort of rare material?
Uh... It's my coursework on awakened machines...
It's got both the rigorous solemnity of industrialization and the poetic romance of stargazing.
It's truly a work of art!
Is... is it really? Ha... haha. Very beautiful indeed.
Is this it?
Right, the passcode of the day is "weather."
Let me see... hmm...
Babylonia, sunny turning cloudy.
Surface operations should pay special attention to...
Tropical cyclones in the East Atlantic.
Which one?
Any of them works. Kusearcher is easy to fool anyway.
What are they doing? What's this passcode they're talking about?
I don't know...
Probably just girls with their secret code talk.
If you ask me...
Gray Raven is the best squad out there right now.
Well, thanks, Captain Obvious.
Just look at their overall stats. They're leagues ahead of everyone else.
Being a plant is amazing.
Forget about apocalypse and viruses—none of it matters.
That's just escapism talking.
Everyone gets mentally exhausted sometimes, you know.
Just looking at some greenery helps ease the strain on my eyes.
Did you forget we're Constructs?
Fine, but what are you doing here anyway?
Just getting some fresh air.
When is the Communication Bulletin going to be synced across all sectors?
Later.
Supplementary communications will be synced along with it.
Sigh... I really hate seeing so many obituaries.
It's supposed to be a perfectly normal occurrence, and yet...
I still find it painful...
Root oxygen level warning. Switching to compensatory irrigation mode.
Help! Don't look at her! Don't look at her!
Why is Tris suspended from duty again?
Uh oh, looks like someone's in a really bad mood...
Eek... I don't wanna step in there.
Is there any way to remove reception duty from the public service rotation?
Feels like we're all being punished along with her.
Has anyone passed that Elementary Mechanoid Course?
Huh? You took Tachikoma's course?
Brave warrior, that's F.O.S. legend.
I never managed to pass any of his courses back then.
What happened?
I heard he intentionally made his courses ridiculously difficult...
So he'd never have to teach.
Huh? Why?
His courses would be removed altogether when too many students failed his courses.
That's a refreshingly carefree approach to life...
This is the plant we encountered in the surface mission last time!
Wow, this is how vibrant you are in full bloom.
Wait, why do I have no recollections at all?
Oh, that's because you were knocked out cold at the time.
Got any plan for break?
I've got some classic Gray Raven operation reviews to catch up on.
Interested in watching them?
Operation reviews? Aren't there plenty of those in the database already?
These are cinema-quality edits! They're incredible!
They even come with HD close-ups of the Gray Raven Commandant.
What? You alright?
No... I just suddenly feel like going back for some extra training.
Huh?
I have no idea.
I get it that military rations don't always taste great, but...
Even the snacks in the dormitory taste awful! Why?!
Hmm... You remember that mission from six months ago, right?
Huh? Oh! I turned off my...
So, you haven't turned your taste sensors back on since then?
Ugh... You know what? Let's stop here.
I can't believe I've become a textbook example of low emotional intelligence...
Buck up! It's just a book that nobody reads!
That's right! We've got tactical evaluations tomorrow!
That's even more depressing...
Don't be sad. Maybe there's been some kind of misunderstanding?
Let's just ask the author of the "Communication Guide" to clear things up.
Yeah... This definitely can't go on.
Your mood is going to tank our evaluation scores.
...Dude, that's not... You're...
...I'm starting to think you're doing this on purpose.
What? Me? No way, buddy!
When I see you upset, it makes me sad, too.
Stop using those cheap techniques from that stupid handbook on me!
Hahaha... Sorry, your reaction is just hilarious.
Aah—I'm stuck! Can someone help me out?
Welcome to Kuroro Coffee!
We've got new items on the menu today! Come in and give them a try!
Hey, isn't that Bianca from the Purifying Force?
Wait, don't tell me their target's here?
Then this place is dangerous!
Shh! Keep it down. She's looking our way!
We took in more refugees from the surface today.
Almost all of them are infected to some degree.
Some still need ongoing medical care...
I just hope they all make it...
Hey, don't beat yourself up. It's not your fault the mission failed.
Surface missions are a mess. You didn't make any mistakes.
Enough! Just let me be alone for a while.
Sigh... I'm up for lunar base duty next shift.
Heard the food up there isn't great.
That's exactly what I'm worried about...
Damn it! Missed it by a second.
Then just wait for the next elevator.
My 30-day perfect attendance plan for the lab...
So, what do you all want to eat?
There's a new Akdilek place. Wanna try it?
Akdilek cuisine, huh... I'd rather go to Kowloong Restaurant.
This mission's so rushed, I didn't even get to eat.
Everyone else here is a Construct. You're the only one who eats.
Eating's one of my favorite hobbies. And besides...
Constructs can eat all they want without worrying about getting fat!
I got careless in the last card game and lost to Rosetta.
This time I'm winning it back. Tell her to come out!
He even tuned his deck just to counter Rosetta.
But... Rosetta's out on a mission today.
Should I add sugar or milk?
Heard Ishmael from the Control Court likes sugar.
Alright, decided! I'm gonna try it their way!
Don't be so uptight. Order whatever you want.
You... what are you planning?
Rebecca just wants to discuss some business.
Did you hear? The other sectors put up new greenhouses.
They say they're growing all kinds of new crops.
No wonder there are so many new ingredients around lately.
Darn it, the drink's stuck in the machine.
Better call one of the patrol mechanoids nearby.
Where should we go for the next squad outing?
I heard a cinema's under construction...
Once it's done, let's go there.
Can't drink this... Way too much sugar...
My weight-loss plan's ruined!
How's that stalled research project of yours going?
I'd rather you not bring it up...
What if we rented this place out and made it a bungee site?
You could jump straight down to Sequence Square... then go shopping!
Wait... you're not planning to skip the safety harness, are you?!
Welcome to Stella Brew.
We offer fine drinks and a relaxing atmosphere.
Set your burdens down and enjoy some peace.
That greeter at the door is really putting in the effort.
Yeah... doesn't look like an easy job.
We're just finishing work while he's starting. Rough shift.
Well, life isn't easy for anyone.
Ever since I got hired, I haven't slept well.
Is the pressure really that bad?
No, I'm just worried I don't fit in...
Heh, that's a luxury problem to have.
How's that Data Storm you ordered?
Tastes like cogs... kind of bitter.
Wait! You didn't order a Construct-only drink, did you?
Who's at the top of the leaderboard?
That score's insane. Must be cheating.
Take a look! It's the Gray Raven Commandant!
Pulling off that score... Yeah, that's our Gray Raven Commandant for you!
Madam? The daily elevator service is complete.
Wow! Thanks, Engineering Force. You guys are fast.
Fast... because we don't have a choice.
Is Captain Karenina really that scary?
N-not at all!
The Commercial District renovation's finally done.
Looks so different from the original plans.
Wasn't there supposed to be a barrier launcher here?
Training's over! Let's grab a drink.
Perfect timing, the cafe's got a new item. I want to try it.
Coffee after work? That's such an office thing.
Yeah, but I really want to try it.
Stella Brew's got something new too. Come on, it's my treat.
This is where I get off. I have a mission.
Take care of yourself. You better come back.
The Business Commercial Council just passed a new renovation plan.
Norman's stock is about to skyrocket.
Damn... I just sold all of mine.
After the renovations, the Commercial District has tons of new terminal beacons.
Cross-district transportation is a lot easier now.
I heard Task Force members often hang out here.
Really? You think I'll run into Chrome?
Did you see that Construct with rainbow hair?
I think that was Noan from Dark Aries.
So stylish! Where'd he get his hair coating done?
I want to try it too.
Short on construction materials? Impossible.
We should reach out to Norman Mining.
Do you think Shark-speares ever eat their own food?
Can a mechanoid even taste like a Construct does?
I checked their menu... Doubt it.
The lunar base just sent back new test data.
All thanks to the Engineering Force.
Don't be so rash next time.
...I'm sorry.
This is a vulnerable species from the Golden Age—Stellar Asparagus.
I heard the council is looking for new investors...
Imma nail this test and join the Science Council!
Welcome to the Orbital Corridor. How may I help you?
Excuse me, where do I go for terminal repairs?
My design proposal got approved!
Leave's canceled. Gather up! We've got a new mission!
Youth Center kids brought more gifts again.
Slow down! No one's going to take it from you!
Boss, another bowl of noodles!
So this food made for Constructs...
Relax, just follow me!
If he doesn't get back soon, the food's gonna be gone.
Hey, I'm talking about you! Save some for him.
(Pending Review) Hmm... this should work.
(Pending Review) ...No, that won't do.
Let's sit a bit longer before heading back to work...
I'm late this time. I should bring something nice to drink to make up for it...
You heard that just now, right?
Your taste seriously needs maintenance.
You're just arguing for the sake of it.
I can't believe nature can create something like this...
Um... can I throw trash in this one?
Huh? Yeah, of course.
I've been carrying this forever. Finally, a place to throw it away.
There are trash cans near the art gallery too.
There's a Kuroro guarding the trash can and not letting anyone use it.
...Tsk. Who tuned this thing?
Hmm... which exhibition should I see?
Military Management Area. Authorization required for entry.
Military Management Area. Authorization required for entry.
Even far from home, you still have to fight to grow...
...Maybe we should just give up.
Why did Imogen leave looking so down just now?
There was supposed to be a special "Vortex School" exhibition...
Her work was selected, then suddenly pulled from the exhibition.
Wow, did the "Vortex" exhibition get pulled again?
That's the second time, isn't it...?
Poor Imogen.
When do I get off duty...?
What should I grab to eat after my shift...
It's rare to get assigned work in the Military Security Area.
I'm still not used to things being this orderly.
Give yourself a break. You don't have to stay tense every day.
Our motto is.
Very awesome!
Super awesome.
It'll be even more awesome in the future.
It's my first day reporting here. I'm totally lost...
I think he's doing okay.
After spending too much time around robots.
The way they're talking isn't exactly normal anymore.
Dealing with robots every day really does...
I should talk to him more often.
Let me see what this does...
Isn't this a bit too sensitive?
We can tweak it.
My eyes are my measuring tools...
Everything's so orderly. It's comforting.
Rifling condition is good.
What's on your mind?
I'm thinking about how to reduce cargo loss during transport.
Maybe we could design a new support structure.
The drones finally got upgraded.
Nothing we can do. This is what happens when it goes on for too long...
The Engineering Force has their hands full.
I hope things can stay peaceful for a while.
You've never been to the top floor of the elevator?
No, I haven't. Now you've got me curious.
And this part can come off too...
The data from this recovery wasn't great.
The layout could be improved. We'll try that next time.
Have you heard of the Starwhisper Project?
I vaguely remember it from a novel.
Turns out it wasn't just made up.
Couples' discount combo, now on sale!
Welcome to today's movie recommendation segment.
This chair isn't going to start massaging people on its own, is it?
There's a VR version too? Hmph, let me "evaluate" it myself.
Huh? I thought you didn't like watching movies?
I'm here to watch F.O.S. Saga 2.
Ah... I see. You graduated from F.O.S.
Heh, not entirely because of that.
I worked as an extra. I even got a close-up.
I have to line up myself? Seriously?
Why is the captain late again...?
Full-sugar popcorn! Awful sugar-free popcorn!
I heard they're making a biopic about Dominik.
Oh no. They always mess up movies like that.
Huh? Why do you say that?
"The Birth of Kowloong" was filmed terribly.
Yeah! No one from Kowloong likes it!
Why did you come out here?
Your movie isn't over yet, is it?
Don't even get me started. The plot was boring, and...
The theater chairs are massaging people again!
Good thing you made it through the Construct modification.
Yep. Barely cheated death.
Either way, we survived.
This spot feels like it could use some reinforcement.
Professor, do you need a hand?
No thanks. I've got this covered.
Is it really okay to leave weapons out in a public area?
These weapons are meant for rapid response attacks.
It's to ensure no one is left defenseless when enemies attack.
Nothing unusual showed up in the routine check.
Let's find a good time to stop and run a full check.
Yeah. It's been like that for a while.
(Stare)
That's it? Babylonia Universal Cinema really needs to work on their taste.
"I long to share in his glory, even in the face of death"…
Finally, somewhere quiet.
I can see you. Why aren't you coming over?
Supplies have been checked. All clear.
So you finally remember to take breaks. That's progress.
They're all classics, but I don't like that one.
You sure you're not gonna run out of coffee beans here with all these people?
Wish: May the hustle and bustle never die.
Sing your hearts out and never let the hustle go to sleep!
Souvenirs sold out. Restocking in progress. Thank you for your patience.
What a lively day today.
I-I totally knew that I picked the right side...
Our new burger is getting rave reviews, rawr!
We, can achieve, mutual benefit, thanks to, the Gray Raven Commandant.
We'll make sure to invite you over for a tasting next time we have new items, rawr!
Getting to enjoy the festival while on shift? Now that's a sweet deal.
Festival special: buy anything, and get the same amount free!
I heard they caught Hertha at your shop?
And the Gray Raven Commandant personally led the operation.
So what exactly went down? Care to spill some details?
Ahem. Actually, I don't know the specifics either...
Hmm... which shop should we check out first?
Wow, this place is classy. Another spot to add to our shopping list.
Hey, check out that store. Looks like they've got some kind of promotion going on.
They're matching whatever you spend? Let's hurry over and check it out!
The lighting is great here. Why don't we take a photo here?
Yeah, let's do it! I'm standing right in the middle!
Can you check if my hair looks okay?
You're good to go! Looking sharp!
Look at the camera, everyone! One, two, three, say cheese!
You gotta try the new burger from Ocean Heart!
It's seasoned with Akdilek's spices and tastes absolutely amazing!
Really? I'm going to grab one right now.
The Kowloong Chamber of Commerce... that's straight ahead, right?
Straight ahead is the exit. What you're looking for is clearly to the left.
It's to the right! You all need to upgrade your navigation modules!
Hey, look at that person over there...
What is it?
Could that be... the Gray Raven Commandant?
It is! Never thought we'd run into them here!
Wow, definitely more impressive in person than in the videos!
Looks like someone just found cat hair in their coffee...
What's been going on with this cafe these days...
Where could the golden fireflies be? Ribbit...
Flowers, branches, and... green grass... ribbit...
Flowers, branches, and... green grass... ribbit...
The Arctic situation...
The higher-ups have a plan. We just wait for orders.
We're inspecting the area. No one is allowed through right now.
The supplies are intact.
Then move them out first!
It's an emergency! Can't you just let it slide?!
Sorry, but we have orders to check everyone.
Where are all the mechanics from the route?
